entries.speaker: Rotating the Camera
entries.en: If you use [clr 2][f 1 10 45][clr 27] you will be able to rotate the[n]camera. If you press [clr 2][f 1 10 70][clr 27] or [clr 2][f 1 10 59][clr 27], you can bring[n]the camera back to its default position.

entries.speaker: Rotating the Camera
entries.en: You can adjust the speed and direction of[n]the camera's rotation in [clr 2]Config[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Rotating the Camera
entries.en: Rotate the camera to look around the city[n]and at the people near you.
